pages.text: Trial chambers hire local. Roughly one chamber in three now staffs its spawners with OreSpawn creatures instead of the vanilla roster — same rooms, same rules, considerably worse tenants.$(p)New chunks only: chambers generated before this addon keep their old payroll. Explore fresh territory.

pages.title: The Roster
pages.text: Melee spawners field $(thing)Ender Knights$() and $(thing)Mantises$() — big, fast, and unimpressed by your shield. Small-melee spawners skitter with $(thing)Scorpions$() and $(thing)Lurking Terrors$(). Ranged duty goes to $(thing)Spit Bugs$(), in regular and slow-firing varieties, both of which aim better than they should.

pages.title: The Pay
pages.text: Trial keys and ominous keys drop exactly as vanilla intended — we don't touch the vault economy. But reward chests and spawner consumables get a pinch of OreSpawn salt: 2-4 uranium or titanium nuggets, buttered salted popcorn, rarely a magic apple or a ruby.$(p)About half the time the pinch is nothing at all. Salt, not gravy.

pages.title: Paper Trail
pages.text: Setting foot in a chamber earns $(thing)Chamber of Trials$(), the first node of the Modern Wonders advancement branch — nine nodes running from here through the $(l:orespawn_integrations:modern_wonders/vault_heist)vault heist$() to $(l:orespawn_integrations:modern_wonders/armor_trims)Kraken couture$().$(p)Quest 704, $(thing)The Trials$(), starts the same tour with a paycheck, then chains into 705 and 706.
